text:
Tara (CS): draft of a tiny customer-facing 'Onboarding Surge Primer' ready for quick review. Goal: a 1-page checklist + tiny troubleshooting hints for caching, batching, streaming that customers can use during ramp/renewal.
Diego (CS Ops): nice. keep it copy-paste friendly. include a decision rule: <=10k req/day -> client warmup; >10k -> dedicated warm pool + autoscale policy.
Tara (CS): yes. sections: 1) warmup commands, 2) batching defaults, 3) stream fallback, 4) renewal signals + who to ping.
Ivy (SRE): ops-safe guidance: recommend client exponential backoff + capped retries. Pseudocode: `sleep = min( base * 2^n + rand(0, jitter), max_sleep )` and cap retries to 5. Note: avoid simultaneous full-tenant prefill at hour boundaries.
Mark (Solutions Eng): two tiny examples to paste:
- prewarm curl:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"tenant":"ACME","keys":["home","help"]}'`
- SDK batch config (one-liner): `{"batch":{"max_delay_ms":50,"max_tokens":1200}}`
June (PM): add renewal-risk thresholds we can share: YELLOW = error_rate >= 2% for 12h OR p95 >= 1.5x SLO for 6h; RED = error_rate >= 3% for 6h OR p95 >= 2x SLO for 4h. Map to CS actions (monitor -> enablement check -> immediate triage).
Tara (CS): include sample Slack alert text customers can forward to us: `ALERT: TENANT ACME -> YELLOW: p95 1.8x SLO. link: <dashboard>` and recommend channels `#cs-alerts` + `@oncall`.
Diego (CS Ops): caching notes: suggest tenant TTL by churn: high-churn=1-2h, medium=4-8h, low=24h. include circuit-breaker idea: disable shared cache for tenants causing >50% of cache evictions in a 1h window.
Mark (Solutions Eng): streaming fallback flow (one-liner): `stream -> attempt resume x2 -> if fail -> return cached snippet + enqueue full gen async (notify via webhook)`. Also request these telemetry keys: `prefill.success_rate`, `prefill.latency.p95`, `stream.resume_attempts`.
Ivy (SRE): recovery tip: if RED persists >3h, recommend temporary routing to a smaller model variant to preserve UX while root cause is investigated.
Telemetry Bot: dashboard created: https://telemetry.redwood.example/d/onboarding-primer (contains p95, error_rate, prefill.success_rate).
Tara (CS): last piece: short consent blurb for telemetry share we can email customers: "We request anonymized runtime metrics to help with onboarding. Reply YES to opt in; we'll provide a short consent template."
June (PM): one-line renewal checklist for CS to send: warm pool enabled, prefill smoke OK, batching config applied, telemetry opt-in confirmed, spike runbook reviewed.
Tara (CS): thanks all. I'll convert this into a 1-page PDF + 1-line email template and post in #customer-success tomorrow morning for final sign-off. Quick nits welcome here. :thumbsup:
